description: Template-generated electoral phishing and benign communications. Synthetic only; no real messages, people or voter records.
suspicious_link_policy: Suspicious URLs use reserved .example domains and RFC 5737 documentation addresses only. Benign URLs reference public institutional home pages as illustrative context and are never contacted by the generator.
known_limitations: Template-generated text is less varied than real reports.
Hausa coverage is limited and requires native-speaker review.
Label noise is deliberately low; real reports are noisier.
The dataset tests triage logic, not actor attribution.
